quandoUsar: Grid or shelf of projects in portfolios, dashboards, and file home screens, where peeking at the first documents on hover gives context.
To show at a glance the kind of content in a folder (text, chart, or image) before opening it.
quandoEvitar: Use `file-tree` to actually navigate files and subfolders, with selection and keyboard.
Use `card-folder` when the content is a set of cards with tabs to read one at a time.
If opening the folder should list or open files, the block alone is not enough: when open, it only draws three sheets, with no links.

teclado.acao: Open or close the folder, spreading out or gathering the sheets.
With focus coming from the keyboard, the folder opens slightly as on mouse hover.

acessibilidade: The whole folder is a native `<button>` with `aria-expanded`; the drawing (tab, sheets, and counter) is `aria-hidden`, so the accessible name comes from the name and the line below it.
When open, the line below swaps the description for the names of the first three sheets plus “and N more”, hardcoded in English, and that is what the screen reader then announces.
The sheet images have empty `alt`, because they are decorative.
movimento: With the mouse over it or keyboard focus, the tab tilts back 24° in 3D and the sheets peek out; on click, the tab opens to 42° and the sheets rise in a fan on a slightly bouncy spring, 45 ms one after another.
The tab uses a heavier spring, with practically no bounce; on close, the sheets return in reverse order and the line under the name swaps with a short slide.
With “reduce motion” on, the tab does not rotate, the sheets jump into place, and the line only fades.
responsivo: Everything scales from `--folder-size` (default 13rem), set on the folder or a parent; the folder reserves space above itself for the sheets to rise, but when open they extend slightly past the sides.
notasIA: Import the named component `ProjectFolder`; the default export is a shelf of three folders where opening one closes the others, built with `open` and `onOpenChange`.
`files` draws only the first three sheets (`kind` `text`, `chart`, or `image`, with `image` for the URL) and counts the rest; to show the real content, react to `onOpenChange`.
Leave side space between neighboring folders for the open fan; `tone="accent"` paints the folder in the accent color and the sheets' paper stays light in both themes.
